svg.aria-label: Architecture of the whole program: data construction, training, one supporter turn, evaluation

g.text: need chain: feeling, need, terminal need;
2 to 4 per person, gaps 1 to 56 days;
the need resolves, grows or shifts
AELS at least 5, no leaked need,
the reply; only the reply is shown
reply, ranked by the base Critic
emotion and needs, each with a quote
caps the rung L0 to L3 by confidence
plans the move within the cap
release if score ≤ λ̂, else revise ≤ 2×
sent to the seeker; memory updates
seeker = Qwen with the adapter off

svg.text: alternatives to the gate, and the reactive baseline
One model on the GPU at a time: Qwen2.5-7B serves the four agents and the simulated seeker as views; the judge loads only after generation ends.
